profile.heading: Profile and appearance
profile.profileDescription: What other members see. Changes save as you make them.

pictures.avatarHelp: Choose a picture, then move and zoom it inside the frame. It is cropped to a square.
pictures.coverHelp: Shown behind your profile, your posts and your member card. Choose a picture, then frame it.
pictures.notAllowed: Your account cannot upload this picture.
pictures.overLimit: This picture is larger than the {size} MB the site allows.
pictures.coverGalleryWorn: A cover from the gallery is worn, so it shows instead of the one you upload. Take it off in Appearance to show yours.
pictures.removeAvatarConfirm: Remove your avatar? The picture is deleted and cannot be brought back.
pictures.removeCoverConfirm: Remove your cover? The picture is deleted and cannot be brought back.
pictures.notImage: Choose an image file (JPEG, PNG, WebP or GIF).

username.label: Username
username.free: You can change your username freely.
username.units: You have {count, plural, one {# change} other {# changes}} left. Each change uses one.

username.limitAll: You have used all the username changes you are allowed.

about.websiteHelp: The address of your site, starting with http:// or https://.
about.birthdayHelp: The year is optional. Only the day and the month show on your profile. Empty all three to remove it.
about.handlesHelp: Your handle on each network, without the @.

title.titleHelp: Up to {count, plural, one {# character} other {# characters}}. Leave it empty to use the title that comes with your group or level.
title.signatureHelp: Written in BB code, for example [B]bold[/B], [I]italic[/I] or [URL=https://example.com]a link[/URL]. Up to {count, plural, one {# character} other {# characters}} and {lines, plural, one {# line} other {# lines}}. Leave it empty to remove it.
title.notShown: You have this saved, but it is not shown at the moment.

title.signaturePictures: up to {count, plural, one {# picture} other {# pictures}}

referral.heading: Invite members
referral.description: Members who register through your link count as your referrals. Links you copy with Share or Copy link carry your code too; a link copied from the address bar does not.
referral.count: {count, plural, one {# member has} other {# members have}} joined through it.

appearance.description: How the forum looks for you, and how you look to everyone else.
appearance.themeDescription: Light, dark, or follow your device. Kept in this browser only.
appearance.previewDescription: Your avatar, name and cover with the choices saved right now.
appearance.accentDescription: Recolours buttons, links and highlights across the whole forum, only for you.
appearance.frameDescription: Shown around your picture everywhere it appears.
appearance.framesEmpty: You have no frames yet. <shop>Get frames in the shop</shop>
appearance.nameColorDescription: The colour of your username in threads, lists and your profile.
appearance.nameColorsEmpty: You have no name colours yet. <shop>Get name colours in the shop</shop>
appearance.nameIconDescription: A small icon next to your username in threads, lists and your profile.
appearance.nameIconsEmpty: You have no name icons yet. <shop>Get name icons in the shop</shop>
appearance.coverDescription: A picture from the gallery behind your profile, your posts and your member card. It shows instead of the cover you uploaded.
appearance.coversEmpty: The gallery needs a perk. <perks>See your perks</perks>

privacy.sectionDescription: Decide who may open your profile, who may post on it and whether others see when you are online.
privacy.postLegend: Who can post on your profile
privacy.onlineHelp: Others can see when you were last active, and you appear among the members online.

members.label: Members
members.help: Any signed-in member who may post.

privacy.ignoredDescription: They cannot notify you, start a conversation with you or post on your profile.

notifications.heading: Notifications
notifications.sectionDescription: Choose where each kind of notification reaches you.
notifications.defaultsHelp: Until you choose, each notification follows the forum's default.
notifications.pushOff: Push notifications are not set up on this forum.

moderation_member.body: A warning, restriction or ban is applied to your account.

moderator_report.body: A report is waiting for a moderator.

moderator_approval.title: Posts waiting for approval
moderator_approval.body: A post is waiting for a moderator to approve it.

announcement.body: The administrators announce something to every member.

moderator_signup.title: New sign-ups
moderator_signup.body: An account is waiting for staff to approve it.

preferences.replyHelp: Whether you follow the threads you reply to.
preferences.homeTabHelp: The tab you land on at the home page. Every tab is one click away whichever you pick.
preferences.shortcutsHelp: Keys such as ? for the list, / to search, j and k to move between posts and g then h to go home.
preferences.threadsDescription: You are told when someone replies in these.
preferences.threadsEmpty: You are not following any thread.
preferences.forumsDescription: You are told about new threads or posts in these.
preferences.forumsEmpty: You are not following any forum.

perks.renameUnits: You have {count, plural, one {# change} other {# changes}} left.

security.heading: Security
security.devicesDescription: Browsers that are signed in to your account.
security.logoutDescription: End your session in this browser.
security.revokeOthersDescription: Ends every session except the one in this browser.
security.devicesNotFresh: For safety, the device list is only available during the first day after you log in. Log out and log in again to see it.
security.devicesFailed: The devices could not be loaded. Try again in a moment.

password.heading: Password
password.description: Choose a new password for your account.
password.signOutOthers: Sign out of all my other devices

email.heading: Email
email.description: The address we use for account messages.
email.unverifiedHint: Confirm your address with the link we send you. Some features stay locked until then.
email.changeHint: We send a link to the new address. Your address changes when you open it.
email.unavailable: Email features are not available on this forum, so the address cannot be confirmed or changed here.

delete.heading: Delete account
delete.warning: This closes your account for good and cannot be undone. Every session ends, and nobody, you included, can sign in to it again.
delete.removes: Removed: your email address and password, your profile details (about, title, signature, location, website, birthday, social handles), your avatar and cover, your push devices, your saved cookie choice, the record of the terms you accepted, the addresses and devices logged for you, who you follow and who follows you, and your referral links.
delete.keeps: Kept: what you wrote (threads, posts, wall posts, messages) stays, under the name Deleted member and a number. So do your credits history and any warnings or moderation log entries about you. Your old name is not rewritten where other members mentioned or quoted you.
delete.confirmMismatch: The username you typed is not yours.

history.retention: The history is kept for {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}.

intro.heading: What a key is for
intro.lead: An API key lets your own scripts, bots and AI agents use the forum as you, without a browser.
intro.rest: Scripts and bots call the REST API: the <link>API reference</link> lists every operation and lets you try them.
intro.mcp:
AI agents connect through MCP at
/mcp
. Either way, send the key as Authorization: Bearer your-key.

warning.heading: Never give your key to anyone
warning.body: Whoever has your key acts as you: they can read your private conversations, post in your name and change your account. Do not paste it into a post, a message or a chat, and do not send it to anyone who asks for it. If you think someone else has it, revoke it at once.

key.heading: Your API key
key.description: You can have one key. It works until you revoke or replace it, or change your password.
key.none: You have no API key yet.
key.several: You have {count, plural, one {# key} other {# keys}} from before the one-key rule. Revoke the ones you no longer use; replacing leaves you with one new key.
key.failed: Your key could not be loaded. Try again later.
key.replaceWarning: A new key takes the place of the current one: anything that uses the current key stops working at once.
key.replaceSeveralWarning: A new key takes the place of all your current keys: anything that uses them stops working at once.
key.revokeWarning: Anything that uses this key stops working at once.

newKey.heading: Your new key
newKey.label: API key
newKey.note: Copy it now and keep it somewhere safe. It will not be shown again: if you lose it, replace it with a new one.

notices.revoked: The key was revoked. Anything that used it no longer works.

errors.exists: You already have a key, listed above. To get a new one, replace it.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a while and try again.
errors.generic: That did not work. Try again.
